006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapKey;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.impl.AbstractStringMapKey;
010
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012
013/**
014 * A base class for untyped atomic items.
015 *
016 * @param <TYPE>
017 *          the Java type of the wrapped value
018 */
019public abstract class AbstractUntypedAtomicItem<TYPE>
020    extends AbstractAnyAtomicItem<TYPE>
021    implements IUntypedAtomicItem {
022
023  /**
024   * Construct a new untyped atomic valued item.
025   *
026   * @param value
027   *          the value
028   */
029  protected AbstractUntypedAtomicItem(@NonNull TYPE value) {
030    super(value);
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  public IMapKey asMapKey() {
035    return new MapKey();
036  }
037
038  private final class MapKey
039      extends AbstractStringMapKey {
040
041    @Override
042    public IUntypedAtomicItem getKey() {
043      return AbstractUntypedAtomicItem.this;
044    }
045
046    @Override
047    public String asString() {
048      return getKey().asString();
049    }
050  }
051}
